data.SimulationState
public class SimulationState <<<<<<< HEAD extends Object
Represents an immutable snapshot of the simulation world at a specific moment in time (tick).

This class is a fundamental part of the Thread-Safe Rendering architecture:

  • The Simulation Manager creates a deep copy of the current vehicle and infrastructure data.
  • It wraps that data in this SimulationState object.
  • This state is passed to the UI thread via the SimulationQueue.

Why copy? As Java passes object references by value, passing raw manager objects to the UI thread would lead to ConcurrentModificationException (race conditions) if the simulation modifies the data while the UI is trying to draw it. By storing copies, this class ensures the View renders a stable state.
